messages:
natalie.r: Noticing intermittent Vault reads failing in prod Canary at 14:05 UTC - app returns KMS unwrap errors. Spinning up a thread to coordinate.
sec-oncall: Thanks. Paste the app error and any recent IAM changes? Any suspect deploys?
natalie.r: Error snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-23T14:05:12Z vault: transit/unwrap error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = kms: cryptoKeyVersion "ck-prod-v2" is disabled
2026-03-23T14:05:12Z http: secret read returned 403
```
ashok.p: I see a job from infra-lee at 13:50 that ran a cleanup script. Checking KMS key versions now.
infra-lee: Yes, I ran an automated tidy that disables older key versions past rotation window. It should have excluded ck-prod-v2 but the filter matched the label incorrectly. Not seeing any external access in audit logs yet.
sec-oncall: Ok treat as accidental disable. Immediate actions: 1) re-enable the key version to restore traffic (owner: infra-lee), 2) stop any automated tidy jobs, 3) snapshot Vault blob state, 4) plan a controlled rewrap to new key version and audit for unauthorized unwraps. Who can take 3?
eng-srm-bot: Snapshot job scheduled: vault-backup-20260323-1500 (owner: ashok.p)
ashok.p: I'll take backups and capture vault audit logs for the last 6 hours. Running: `gcloud kms keys versions enable 2 --key ring prod-ring --location global --key ck-prod --project redwood-prod` to enable v2? Wait, double-checking versions.
infra-lee: Confirmed: version 2 was disabled. Re-enabled at 14:12 UTC. Canary reads recovered. Turning off tidy job and rolling back the change.
partner-cp: Heads-up from partner infra: we ingest anonymized observability logs; we saw a few entries referencing the key id around 14:05 but no ciphertext. We'll need to share an incident minimal notice.
natalie.r: Good. Next we should harden the tidy script to respect an allowlist label `kms-managed=true`. Also add a preflight dry-run that fails if it would disable an active key.
sec-oncall: Add temporary RBAC lock for key version disable action so only an emergency group can disable keys until we patch the script. Create IAM condition requiring `request.time < timestamp("2026-03-24T00:00:00Z")` and membership in group `kms-admins`.
ashok.p: I'll implement the IAM constraint and test in staging. Also propose adding a synthetic canary that monitors unwrap latency and fails if >0.5% unwrap errors.
infra-lee: For rewrap plan: create new version v4, then rewrap using Vault operator rewrap in batches of 500 secrets with 2m pause between batches. Schedule for 02:00-04:00 UTC to keep low traffic. We'll run a dry-run on 50 secrets first.
natalie.r: Add verification steps: 1) telemetry verification (unwrap rate, error delta), 2) smoke tests for critical routes, 3) audit log check for any `decrypt` events from unknown principals.
natalie.r: Also we should rotate any short-lived tokens that were minted around 13:40-14:20 as a precaution. I will list token issuers.
sec-oncall: Agree. Run a quick creds-scan for tokens and sessions in that 40-minute window. Ashok, can you coordinate token rotation sweep?
ashok.p: On it. I'll revoke affected sessions and rotate CI tokens that have write permissions to KMS on prod. Will post summary when done.
infra-lee: Dry-run rewrap complete on 50 test secrets, no consumer breakages. Starting full rewrap at 02:05 UTC as planned.
natalie.r: Backups taken and stored in GCS encrypted bucket. Partner notified with minimal info: no plaintext, key id only.
natalie.r: Rewrap finished at 02:44 UTC. Canary & consumer apps validated. v2 remains disabled after verification.
sec-oncall: Final status: incident contained, root cause mislabel in tidy script. Actions: infra-lee will patch tidy script and add dry-run, ashok.p will finish tokens sweep and post token rotation list, natalie.r will send partner follow-up and draft post-incident report, sec-oncall will schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow.
eng-srm-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-740 - owners assigned.
partner-cp: Thanks for the quick coordination. We confirm no sensitive payloads were retained.
_meta: generated for dataset: secrets management incident - production KMS key disable due to tidy script mislabel
